messages:
maria: Starting rolling deploy for release v2.8.0 to eu-west1 canaries. change window ends in 18m. will run burst smoke (100 QPS, 30s) after canary up.

deploy-bot: canary rollout succeeded on service/embed-canary (3 pods). image: embed:v2.8.0. timestamp=1837654322

sam: kicking off burst smoke now against canary endpoint /v1/generate - baseline 50ms p95 on main.

sre-bot: synthetic probe summary (initial): kv-probe OK, heartbeat ok, consumer_lag p95=560ms, p99=1.1s, errors=0. spike aligns with burst window.

tj: seeing tail latency jump on logs: "batcher: flush took 820ms, items=48". looks like batching jitter when concurrency>40.

maria: hmm, did anything change in batching config or model kernel selection in this release?

sam: PR #2145 changed default max_batch_size from 64->48 to reduce mem. but kernel path for quantized op also changed to use fast-int8 in v2.8.0. could be interaction.

ben: if it's quant path, pinning to model runtime 1.4.2 (old kernel) should isolate. full rollback more disruptive.

maria: agreed. options: 1) rollback fully to v2.7.3 2) pin model runtime to 1.4.2 for canaries and pause rollout 3) continue and watch for 10m with extra monitoring.

sam: recommend option 2. pin + pause, re-run smoke. low blast radius and quick revert.

maria: ok. @deploy-bot can you pause the global rollout and patch canary config to pin model_runtime=1.4.2?

deploy-bot: Rollout paused for release v2.8.0. Applying patch: canary.embed.runtime=model_runtime:1.4.2. action_id=act-7782.

sam: running burst smoke again now (100 QPS). keeping new relays throttled.

sre-bot: re-run synthetic: consumer_lag p95=120ms, p99=220ms, kv-probe success=100%, embed p95=210ms. No errors.

tj: logs show batcher flush ~180ms now. kernel path back to old code. looks good.

ben: filing INF-3429 to track quant kernel regression + test to simulate high-concurrency batching with patch.

maria: good catch. we'll hold rollout for 30m and watch metrics. I'll update release notes and notify support and the oncall.

sam: added canary pin to release note draft. re-run full smoke at +10m.

maria: thanks everyone. feel free to :thumbsup: on the PR when you confirm.

tj: :thumbsup:

maria: action items: INF-3429 (regression), patch applied to canary, rollout paused, will resume after steady metrics.
